title: Retail Plan Price Computation — Kessler Care Replacement Purchases
content:
# Retail Plan Price — How the Figure Is Reached

**Basis.** A replacement purchase of a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans retail plan (Essentials, Plus or Premium) is priced from the retail basis price, which is the retail plan price of the plan name bought. The retail plan price is that retail basis price rounded half up to the cent.

**Combination.** Where a rate applies to the plan, it reduces the retail basis price once. Credits that apply are then added together and subtracted from that reduced price. A result below 0.00 is 0.00, so the credits never make the price negative. The retail plan price is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

| Step | Operation |
|---|---|
| 1 | Retail basis price |
| 2 | Where a rate applies: the basis price times one less that rate (applied once) |
| 3 | Less the total of the credits that apply |
| 4 | Below 0.00 becomes 0.00 |
| 5 | Round half up to the cent |

**Worked figures (hypothetical).**
- With nothing further applying, a basis price of 455.555 gives 455.56.
- A basis price of 620.00, a rate of 0.05 and credits of 12.00 and 18.00 give 620.00 times 0.95, which is 589.00, less 30.00, which is 559.00.
- A basis price of 24.00 with credits of 40.00 gives 0.00.

These inputs are invented for illustration.
